elements.evidence: Section 10.9 limits “each Party's total aggregate liability.”

elements.element: The cap equals the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 10.9 uses this greater-of formula verbatim.
Section 10.9 states that “neither Party shall be liable to the other for any indirect ... damages.”
Section 10.9 states that “neither Party shall be liable to the other for any ... consequential damages.”

result.reason: The added clause fully implements the preferred position and does not alter the existing operative provisions. The fallback is independently not fully satisfied because its specified cap is exactly 12 months' fees, whereas the rendered cap includes a USD 1,000,000 floor. Drafting quality is reduced by the unexplained use of both “Customer” and “Company” for the payment-obligation clarification; if they are not the same defined party, that sentence could misdirect the exclusion.
